the methodology for conflict resolution in the integration of entity relationship schemas is a process that involves the identification of the conflicts that exist in the schemas to be integrated, and then the resolution of these conflicts.

the integration of two or more entity relationship schemas, each of which is a model of a different data base.
the development of a methodology for the integration of heterogeneous entity-relationship schemas.
the problem of integrating entity-relationship schemas that have been developed in different application domains and that may be based on different conceptual models of the real-world.

it is possible to use a combination of structural and behavioral conflict detection and resolution techniques to achieve a more complete conflict resolution.
